test_title: PYST 26: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**great**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "to the _____ confusion of the traffic" describes the degree of confusion caused by the old lady's actions.
 
• An adjective is required to modify the noun "confusion".
 
• "**Great**" is an adjective meaning considerable or large in degree, which accurately describes the significant confusion caused by walking in the middle of a street.
 
• The other options are either incorrect parts of speech or do not make sense in the context of describing the degree of confusion.

 

Complete Passage: *That was a jolly story 1. which__ Arthur Ransome told the other day in one of his messages from Petrograd, a place in Russia. A stout old lady was walking 2. __with__ her basket down the middle of a street to the 3. __great__ confusion of the traffic and with no small peril to herself. It was pointed 4. _____ to her that the 5. _____ was the place for the foot passengers, but she replied, “I’m going to walk where I like. We’ve got liberty now.”*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Greet: (verb) to address someone with a friendly or polite formula.
 
• Grate: (noun) a metal framework; (verb) to shred food; to annoy.
 
• Garret: (noun) a top-floor room, especially a small dark one.
